purpose: design the internal structure of one system so that it meets its quality targets and can be changed safely
entry_criteria: The solution architecture and quality targets exist (stages 14, 23)
Technology choices are known or being made
The team who will build it is known
procedure: Select an architectural style that fits the quality targets and team, such as modular monolith or services, and state why.
Divide the system into components with one clear responsibility each and rules for who may depend on whom.
Design data flow, state, and failure handling: timeouts, retries, idempotency and degradation.
Describe how the design meets each quality target, for example scaling, recovery and observability.
Define the deployment shape and the environments, and how configuration is handled.
Write decision records, and turn the dependency rules into automated checks.
acceptance_criteria: Each quality target maps to a design element
Dependency rules are written and checkable
Failure behavior is designed, not left to defaults
The style choice has a stated reason

validation.check: list each quality target and the design element that meets it
validation.expect: no target left without an element

validation.check: check the dependency rules can be expressed in a tool and run in CI

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A modular monolith is chosen for a team of six; modules own their tables and may call each other only through interfaces, and a dependency rule in CI rejects direct table access across modules.
